subject.title: fix(repair): close staged proof review gaps

question: Should maintainers adopt the shared durable queue drainer and sealed authenticated requeue contract as the repair lane's production operating model?
rationale: The implementation is well-tested and has no remaining concrete defect, but it deliberately centralizes delivery and changes cross-workflow authorization interfaces whose long-term operational ownership requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt the green head
options.body: Accept the reviewed durable queue, recovery, and authorization contract and merge this exact head.

options.title: Split risky boundaries
options.body: Separate shared queue delivery from requeue authorization and staged-proof hardening for narrower production rollouts.

options.title: Pause adoption
options.body: Keep the current repair model and redesign or close this draft if maintainers do not want the new shared interfaces.

recommendation.title: Adopt the green head
recommendation.body: Accept the reviewed durable queue, recovery, and authorization contract and merge this exact head.
